Hi Elena / Samir — thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side so we have alignment: 

Summary of what we heard
- ClearWave will be storing PHI for referral routing (HIPAA scope) and needs a BAA.
- Primary asks: SOC 2 evidence (Type II preferred), in-transit + at-rest encryption details, and the ability to use customer-managed keys (BYOK/CMEK) with HSM-backed keys for heightened control.

Answers / material we can share immediately
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type I report from Jun 2025; Type II is in progress and the audit is targeted for completion in Q1 2027. We can share the Type I now and the Type II once available.
- HIPAA: We do offer a Business Associate Agreement; we'll surface our BAA template and typical scoping language.
- Encryption: TLS 1.3 in transit; AES-256-GCM for data at rest for hosted environments. For Dedicated / Private deployments we also support HSM-backed key stores and hardware root-of-trust options.
- BYO-KMS: Supported via envelope encryption patterns with AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS, and Azure Key Vault. For hosted Redwood we do not import raw key material into our control plane — the CMK stays in your KMS and we call it for envelope wrapping. For Private deployments we can integrate with customer HSMs or CloudHSM.

Asks / next steps
1) Elena — can you confirm the SOC 2 Type II timing requirement (must-have vs nice-to-have) and whether there are any specific auditor evidence artifacts you need now?
2) I'll loop Rafael (crypto/ops) for the technical deep-dive. Would you prefer a 30-45m technical session (HSM + KMS architecture) or a short questionnaire first?
3) I attached a brief one-pager on BYO-KMS options (redwood-byo-kms-options.pdf) and will send our security questionnaire if you'd like to kick that off.

Proposed times for follow-up technical call: Tue Dec 1 09:00–11:00 PT or Wed Dec 2 13:00–15:00 PT. Let me know what works and I’ll send an invite.

Regards,

Elena — thanks for the intake and the clear asks. Quick technical responses to the items in tab 2 and notes on controls: 

SOC2 / compensating controls
- If Type II is required within 12 months we can discuss a contractual commitment and a transition plan; in many cases we provide additional compensating controls and extended audit evidence (control mappings, configuration snapshots) while the Type II audit completes.

KMS / CMEK model
- Hosted Redwood API: We implement envelope encryption where customer CMKs (in AWS KMS / GCP KMS / Azure Key Vault) generate data keys that are used to encrypt model caches and storage. The CMK stays in your KMS; Redwood stores only encrypted envelopes and does not have access to raw plaintext CMKs.
- Dedicated / Private: For Private deployments we support direct HSM integration (PKCS#11 or CloudHSM) and can optionally configure the runtime so that KMS calls are routed over your private network.
- HSM attestation: For on-prem HSMs we can verify attestation artifacts as part of the onboarding (for example AWS Nitro enclaves / HSM attestation evidence for CloudHSM). For hosted solutions we rely on the KMS provider's attestation and can provide architecture diagrams and call traces.

Key rotation and auditing
- Rotation: We support customer-driven rotation schedules. Standard options: 30/90/180 days or custom intervals. Rotation does not require redeploying models; we handle envelope key re-wrapping at the storage layer.
- Audit hooks: We provide per-key KMS call logs surfaced in the Console for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted customers we provide usage logs and can integrate with your SIEM via secure forwarding. Detailed audit exports can be added to our Premium observability package.

Suggested next steps
1) I attached a short technical appendix (embedded as part of the redwood-byo-kms-options.pdf Sofia sent) that maps ClearWave intake fields to our evidence artifacts.
2) If you prefer, we can take the ClearWave intake workbook and populate our responses directly into tab 2 and return it.
3) Proposed technical session: Tue Dec 1 10:00–10:45 PT — Rafael + Sofia + Vanessa from Redwood, Elena + Samir from ClearWave. I’ll stand up a calendar invite if that time works.

If you want, we can provide a short video that shows a demo of envelope flows (CMEK wrap/unwrap) in both the Hosted and Private topologies.
